description: The root network boundary convention that replaces middleware.ts, executing on the Node.js runtime before cached routes and application handlers to perform rewrites, redirects, and header mutations.
A route filter exported from proxy.ts that restricts which incoming URLs invoke the proxy function, typically excluding static assets and image optimization endpoints.

A proxy pattern that inspects the incoming Host header (such as acme.app.local) and transparently rewrites the URL to an internal dynamic route segment (/tenants/acme) while keeping the browser URL unchanged.
A fast boundary check in proxy.ts that inspects the presence of a session cookie to redirect unauthenticated users early without querying a database.

A security architecture where proxy.ts handles outer routing ergonomics while the Data Access Layer and Server Actions independently verify session validity, tenant ownership, and user roles before touching data.
